master.title: Building the Boring Part of the Energy Transition
master.challenge: Storage projects were being approved faster than anyone could connect them. The constraint had moved from generation to interconnection, and nobody was building for it.
master.investmentThesis: The bottleneck was engineering capacity, not capital. A firm that could industrialise interconnection studies would sit in front of every project in the queue.
master.outcome: Placeholder outcome. Where an outcome is not yet known, this field says so rather than implying one.
